extracted.name: Slow Cooker Creamy Ranch Pork Chops
extracted.description: This Slow Cooker Pork Chops recipe is the ultimate hands-off dinner with pork chops simmered low and slow in a rich, savory sauce that makes the meat tender and flavorful.
ingredient_lines: 10.5 oz can cream of mushroom soup ((or homemade))
10.5 oz can cream of chicken soup ((or homemade))
2 chicken bouillon cubes (crushed (or 2 tsp bouillon paste))
instruction_lines: Spray your slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray and place pork chops on the bottom. Mix together the remaining ingredients and pour over the pork chops. Cook on LOW for 5-6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours.
Serve over mashed potatoes or rice with a side of cooked or Roasted Vegetables.
categories: Fall apart slow cooker pork chops
